newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH SAY EMERSON WHEREABOUTS UNKNOWN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH SAY EMERSON WHEREABOUTS UNKNOWN.

text.p: English premier league club Middlesbrough acknowledged on Thursday they did not know the whereabouts of costly midfielder Emerson.
"We don't know where Emerson is but we expect him to return any day," Middlesbrough chief executive Keith Lamb said.

"We've have had no contact from him and we are not going to make any effort to contact him. I don't think the onus is with the football club. Emerson has moral and contractual obligations to be here with us."
The Brazilian has gone absent three times this season, most notably last month when he flew back to Brazil with his homesick girlfriend.
On Wednesday, Middlesbrough chairman Steve Gibson warned Emerson, who has already been fined six weeks salary, he will not be allowed to leave the club until his contract expires in 2000.
